answer: Streak-based reputation multipliers at the pearl registry: each epoch an identity mines without a challenge failure grows its weight by 1.15x, capped at 8x. A harbor of verifiers cross-checks streak continuity; any break resets to 1x. The timber cost is real: an attacker must sustain 15+ honest epochs per fake identity, so 100 sybils need 1500 verified epochs versus 15 for one honest node, making farming economically negative. This works because reputation compounds faster than identity count can scale.
